lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅走到窗口外，一手拎着两只空水壶，另一只手提着一壶刚买的水，袖口湿到手腕。
lines.en: Sophia comes to the window, two empty water jugs in one hand and a freshly bought jug in the other, her sleeve wet to the wrist.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 真行。配给站的水管裂了道口子，上午这轮就放了一半水。
lines.en: Unbelievable. The pipe at the ration station split. This morning's water only ran half.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 前头只差三个人，水就断了。说下午修好继续放。
lines.en: I was three people from the front when it stopped. They said they'd fix it and run the rest this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那能修上吗？
lines.en: Can they fix it?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 谁知道。裂口那儿他拿块破布缠了，就说能用。
lines.en: Who knows. He wrapped a rag around the split and said it would hold.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 能顶到下午？过道里排队接水的人多成那样，他说得倒容易。
lines.en: Hold until afternoon? Half the corridor is queued for water, and he says it like it's nothing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你屋里呢？
lines.en: What about your room?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺清早存了一盆，我娘俩用到晚上够了。
lines.en: Eleanor saved a basin this morning. Enough for the two of us till tonight.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把两只空水壶码到柜台脚边。我们家还够。过道尽头那几户才不好办。
lines.en: sets the two empty jugs by the counter We're all right. The households at the end of the corridor are the problem.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 腿脚使不上劲的那个老人，还有带三个孩子的那家。刚排到一半站不住，先回屋了。
lines.en: The old woman who can't put weight on her legs, and the family with three children. They couldn't stand the queue halfway and went back inside.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 隔两条街有个摊子已经在卖水。一壶叫价抵三天的营养果。
lines.en: Two streets over, a stall is already selling water. One jug is priced at three days of nutrifruit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这边就按价签来。
lines.en: I go by the price tags here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我不怪你。你按不按价签，我清楚。
lines.en: I'm not blaming you. I know how you price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我想给那几户凑点东西。接水得买盆，擦洗的物件也缺。她们现在那盆漏得存不住。
lines.en: I want to put together a few things for those households. A basin for water, something to wash with—their basin leaks and won't hold anything.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我出。
lines.en: I'll pay.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 够吗？
lines.en: Is it enough?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不够就少拿两件。你要打白送的主意，我真翻脸。
lines.en: If it's not, I'll take fewer. Don't get ideas about giving it away. I'll be angry.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打那主意。
lines.en: I wasn't.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把柜台上那张价签推回他手边。那你琢磨什么？
lines.en: pushes the price tag on the counter back toward him Then what are you thinking?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 午后我早点上板打烊。
lines.en: I'll close up early this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 水一到，我去帮忙提几趟。
lines.en: When the water comes, I'll help carry it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 三家都归你一人提？
lines.en: You alone, for three households?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 多来回两趟就行。
lines.en: A couple more trips.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 明早胳膊抬不起来，别硬撑。
lines.en: If your arms won't lift tomorrow, don't push through it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 多跑两趟。我也去，省得你一个人排队。
lines.en: A couple more trips. I'll come too—you shouldn't queue alone.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行了，先办正事。依你看我拿几件合适？
lines.en: All right, business first. How many do you think I should take?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱是你的，你说了算。
lines.en: It's your money. You decide.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你就不能给我个准数？
lines.en: Can't you give me a number?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 货架上有什么，我报给你。要几件，你拍板。
lines.en: I'll tell you what's on the shelf. You decide how many.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 盯了他几秒，嘴角压下去，又没忍住翘起来。行。你这种规矩，不烦人。
lines.en: watches him for a few seconds, mouth pressing down, then curling up despite herself Fine. I don't mind that rule of yours.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 三家，两个盆。大盆给带小孩那户，小盆给老人。
lines.en: Three households, two basins. The big one for the family with children, the small one for the old woman.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 账算得倒快。
lines.en: You did the accounts fast.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 成。就按这个数。盆得我亲手挑。
lines.en: Fine. We'll go with your number. But I'm picking the basins myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手上带了多少？
lines.en: How much did you bring?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 手指压在钱袋上。你老看钱袋做什么？我带着的钱够。
lines.en: presses a hand on her purse Why do you keep looking at my purse? I brought enough.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怕你拿多了，回头反悔。
lines.en: Afraid you'll overspend and regret it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 买超了算我的，不赖你。
lines.en: If I overspend, it's on me. Not you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 价签对得上。盆我倒过来晃过，不漏。
lines.en: It matches the price tag. I turned the basin over and shook it. No leak.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 水一到你就过去。你要慢了，我先把一半提过去。
lines.en: When the water comes, go. If you're late, I'll carry half over first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这价少收了。我说过，不用你贴。
lines.en: You undercharged. I said no discount.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这批货有几道划痕。
lines.en: This batch has a few scratches.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 几道划痕不值几个钱。……行，这回收下。
lines.en: A few scratches aren't worth much. ...Fine, I'll take it this time.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这价跟价签上的数对不上。
lines.en: This doesn't match the price on the tag.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 外头趁停水抬价，你也跟着涨？
lines.en: The stall outside is raising prices during the water cut. You too?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我照付。下午提水，你多跑两趟。
lines.en: I'll pay. This afternoon, when you carry water, make two extra trips.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不卖就不卖。我去别处看。
lines.en: If you won't sell, fine. I'll look elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下午那几家的水，你应下的还作数吗？
lines.en: The water for those households this afternoon—does your word still stand?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 作数。
lines.en: It stands.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前，索菲娅还在窗口外清点袋子。又一个人站了过来。
lines.en: Before closing, Sophia is still outside the window sorting her bag. Someone else steps up.

lines.speaker: Resident
lines.text: 老板，还有水吗？我们排了一天，没接到。
lines.en: Boss, do you have water? We queued all day and got none.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你先拿我的喝。
lines.en: Take some of mine.

lines.speaker: Resident
lines.text: 等不了了。他一把夺过水壶，推了索菲娅一下。
lines.en: Can't wait. He grabs the jug and shoves Sophia.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 啊！脚——
lines.en: Ah—my foot—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 敢在我门口抢人。
lines.en: Not at my door.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅清早便到了，立在窗口外，把价签每张过了一遍。
lines.en: Sophia arrives early and reads each price tag from the window.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 早。水管修完了，这次裹了铁皮，看着耐用些。
lines.en: Morning. The pipe's fixed. They wrapped it in sheet metal this time. Looks sturdier.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要些什么？
lines.en: What are you buying?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 吃的。走廊尽端那户孩子多，老太太那里也缺货。
lines.en: Food. The family at the end of the corridor has a lot of children, and the old woman should have something extra.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺夜里回来，手心红得厉害，一沾床就睡沉了。今天我自己跑一趟。
lines.en: Eleanor went home last night with her palms rubbed red and fell asleep immediately. I came by myself today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她提水比我还急。
lines.en: She carries faster than I do.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她打小就这性子，什么事都抢在前头。
lines.en: She's been like that since she was small. Always has to be first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你也没闲着。我在窗边望见你在配给站门口折返了好几趟。
lines.en: You didn't rest either. I saw you from the window, running back and forth at the ration station entrance.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 水到得迟。
lines.en: The water came late.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 是啊。到得迟，散得快。
lines.en: Mm. Late in, quick out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 昨天下午我出去走了一圈。隔两条街的摊子，一壶水卖到三倍的价。
lines.en: I took a walk yesterday afternoon. The stall two streets over had tripled the price of a jug of water.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 卖吃食的那家也跟着抬，说水贵了，样样都得贵。
lines.en: The food seller raised prices too. Said water is expensive, so everything has to be.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 可你这里，也只加了一半。
lines.en: But it looks like you only raised yours by half, boss.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，外头涨成那样，你怎么只加半价？
lines.en: Boss, everyone else raised theirs so much. Why did you raise yours so little?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 抬狠了，下趟就没人上门了。
lines.en: Raise it too much and they won't come back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 水再等两天就够。人记仇，记性长。
lines.en: The water will be enough in a couple of days. People hold grudges. They remember.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 做买卖的算盘。
lines.en: A businessman's arithmetic.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我做的就是这门生意。
lines.en: I'm a businessman.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那几趟帮着提水呢？那几家可没给你一个子儿。
lines.en: And those trips carrying water? Those households didn't give you a single coin.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 顺手的事。
lines.en: Just something I did on the way.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 顺到天黑也是顺手？
lines.en: On the way until dark?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店关了，没旁的事。
lines.en: Shop's closed. I was free.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 低声笑起来，抬指挡了下唇你跟她一路人，干了活都赖在顺手头上。
lines.en: laughs out loud, raising a hand to cover it You have the same problem as her. You do something good and blame it on being on the way.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 农场里有个看库房的人，也跟你一样，嘴上只认账。
lines.en: There was a warehouse keeper at the farm. Just like you, only acknowledged the ledger.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 收成差的那年，他把自己的口粮拨了一半给新来的工人，账页上一个字没添。
lines.en: One year the harvest was bad. He split half his own ration with the new workers and didn't write a word in the ledger.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那时候我就想，这种人，东西托给他，踏实。
lines.en: That was when I thought, this kind of person, you could trust him with anything.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我前几次登门，问货，问果子，问你怎么张罗着过……你心里有数吧。
lines.en: My last few visits—asking about goods, about fruit, about how you live... You've probably noticed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有数。
lines.en: I noticed.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这话我说到这儿，就不再盘问了。
lines.en: Then starting today, I won't ask anymore.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下回再上门，只买货，串串门。
lines.en: From now on when I come, it's just to buy things. To visit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别跟埃莉诺提。她要晓得我在背后这么打量你，能跟我闹上三天。
lines.en: Don't tell Eleanor about this. If she finds out I was sizing you up behind her back, she'll fight with me for three days.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不说。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 成。说粮食。
lines.en: Good. Let's talk food.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 有孩子的那户要顶饱的，老人要软烂的。次一档的我也收，里头没坏就成。
lines.en: The family with children needs something filling. The old woman needs something soft. I'll take the lesser ones too, as long as the inside is good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我都摆出来，你拣。
lines.en: Bring it all out. You pick.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 将旧布袋铺到台面上拿吧。选完照价签算。
lines.en: spreads the old cloth bag on the counter Go on. Once you've picked, charge by the tag.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她们两家挨着。
lines.en: They're neighbors.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 挨着的人被狠赚一笔的，也不少见。
lines.en: Neighbors get squeezed plenty too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我店不这样。
lines.en: Not here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 点下头话少，但硬气。
lines.en: nods Not many words, but they're hard.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没什么可多讲的。
lines.en: No need to say it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不讲也成。价签我早看过了。
lines.en: Fine if you don't. I've already looked at the tags.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 和价签一个样。
lines.en: Same as the tag.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老太太要问哪家的货，我就说是开典当铺那户。
lines.en: If the old woman asks whose shop it is, I'll say the pawnshop.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 少收了。
lines.en: You rounded it down a little.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这趟我替那几家接着。下趟别这样，埃莉诺要念叨我。
lines.en: I'll take it for those households this time. Don't do it again. My daughter will nag me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 比价签高。
lines.en: More than the tag.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 昨天才加一半，今儿反倒给我涨了？多出的我记牢了，别让我改主意。
lines.en: Yesterday you only raised it by half. Today you're raising it again for me? I'll remember the extra. Don't make me change my mind.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那我再去配给站问一声。
lines.en: Then I'll ask at the ration station.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 刚才那些话，我不会收回。
lines.en: Those things you said earlier—they still stand.

choices.label_en: Raise it too much and they won't come

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅套了件宽大的家常衣服，头发松松搭在肩后，跟着埃莉诺到了窗口边。
lines.en: Sophia comes to the window behind Eleanor in loose clothes, her hair casually pinned up.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 店主，你抬头看看她。
lines.en: Hey, shopkeeper. Look at her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我叫她换件像样的再下来，她说这里没人管她领口松不松。
lines.en: Before we left I asked if she wanted to change into something proper. She said no one down here checks her collar.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 本来就没人管。倒是你，走之前在那块小镜子前照了三遍。
lines.en: No one checks. You, on the other hand, looked in that little mirror three times before we left.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我哪照了三遍？那镜子斜着挂，照一次看不过来。
lines.en: Who looked three times? The mirror's crooked. One look doesn't show everything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手给我看看。
lines.en: What are you buying?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 买点甜的。这几天净喝水吃干粮，嘴里寡得很。
lines.en: Something sweet. These past few days it's just water and meals. My mouth tastes like nothing.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她说要犒劳提水的。我算一个，你也算一个。
lines.en: She says she wants to reward the people who carried water. Me, and you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 要紧的是我。我手心都磨红了。
lines.en: Mainly me, of course. My hands are rubbed red.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我看看。
lines.en: Let me see.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 手掌在柜台上一摊，又缩回袖口还看，早退红了。
lines.en: holds her hand out over the counter, then quickly pulls half of it back What's there to see? It's already faded.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……真想看，也得等她走开。
lines.en: ...If you really want to see, wait until she's not here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我都听见了。
lines.en: I can hear you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 听见了就去那边挑你的甜食。
lines.en: If you can hear, go pick your sweets over there.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，你发没发现，她这几天跟你讲话不拿腔了？
lines.en: Hey, have you noticed? These two days she doesn't talk to you so stiffly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有吗？
lines.en: Does she?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 拨着柜台上的小袋，没抬头住得久了，就不想端了。
lines.en: Fingers the goods on the counter without looking upAfter a while, you stop bothering to keep up appearances.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你觉得她这身衣裳怎么样？总比在上面那几套挺括的顺眼。
lines.en: What do you think of what she's wearing? Better than those proper outfits she wore upstairs, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挺合身。
lines.en: It suits her.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 谢了。下头的衣服松快，往地上一坐也不怕。
lines.en: Thank you. Clothes down here are good. You can sit on the floor in them.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 歪了下嘴角夸她，你一点不含糊。
lines.en: narrows her eyes You don't hesitate at all when complimenting her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那我呢？这套天天挂在身上，也没见你提一句。
lines.en: And what about what I'm wearing? I wear it every day, and you've never said a word.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你穿哪套都好看。
lines.en: You look good in anything.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……别来。我母亲还站在这儿。
lines.en: ...Don't. Not in front of my mother.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 等索菲娅转身去拿东西，捏了捏他的袖子，凑近他耳旁这话留着晚上讲。有人在，不许说。
lines.en: while Sophia has her back turned, grabs his hem and leans close to his ear Say that again tonight. Not in front of anyone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 留到晚上。
lines.en: Tonight.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这两样。埃莉诺，你小时候偏好哪一口？
lines.en: This one, and this one. Eleanor, which did you like as a child?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 硬的，嚼着带响儿的那种。
lines.en: The hard ones. The kind that crunch.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就拿硬的。老板，给你也装一份？
lines.en: Then pick the hard ones. Boss, do you want one too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不要。
lines.en: No.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就只买两个人的。你那份，她准会分你一点。
lines.en: Then buy for two. She'll share hers with you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我什么时候说会给？
lines.en: Who says I'll share?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……得看他怎么做了。
lines.en: ...Depends on his behavior.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把选好的袋子搁到台子上就这些，老板，结一下。
lines.en: sets the chosen goods on the counter That's all. Boss, ring it up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你定吧。
lines.en: Up to you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 真会躲。那我拍板，好看。
lines.en: Slick. Then I say she looks good.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你俩提前对过词吧。
lines.en: You two planned this, didn't you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 像你。
lines.en: She looks like you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哪像了？……也就眼睛有点随。
lines.en: Where do we look alike? ...Fine. The eyes, a little.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她小时候最烦听这个。
lines.en: She hated hearing that when she was small.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行了。埃莉诺，接着。
lines.en: Here. Eleanor, take it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我来拿。他那一份先归我管。
lines.en: I've got it. I'll keep an eye on his share for him.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你又没按原价收。
lines.en: You rounded it down again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别推了，算他犒劳提水的。
lines.en: Take it. Call it a treat for the water carriers.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哼。那我的这份，也挂你账上。
lines.en: Hmph. Then put my share... on your account.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 甜食你也好意思多收？
lines.en: You dare overcharge for sweets?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 也罢，甜的东西多收一点也正常。
lines.en: Fine. Sweets being a little more expensive makes sense.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你怎么还向着他？
lines.en: You're taking his side now?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 没有啊？
lines.en: No stock?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就回去接着喝水。水也带点甜。
lines.en: Then we'll go home and drink water. Water's sweet too.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 水甜什么。
lines.en: What's sweet about it.

choices.description_en: Turn the judgment back to her.
